entries.description: Read-only JSON API describing Ranatec AB (Gothenburg, Sweden) — RF test & measurement equipment for filtering, shielding, switching and automation — plus two consent-gated POST endpoints: product quote requests and contact enquiries. Content mirrors ranatec.com in three regional English locales (en-US default, en-GB, en-CA); every entity lists all three URLs. Ranatec publishes no prices: all products are sold B2B via request for quote.
